changes: Adds a fast service-off desktop launch path when the private CPython runtime already exists, bypassing the compatibility Bootstrap/Core chain during normal established-runtime startup.
Adds a constant-time /api/health?startup=1 probe so launcher readiness checks do not invoke SAB engine status, tool discovery, or full diagnostics.
Defers SAB coordination workers and Automation queue reconciliation until after the localhost HTTP listener is available.
Defers preview and thumbnail cache housekeeping until after cold startup so disk maintenance cannot contend with backend/UI readiness.
Opens the Chromium app window immediately after the current-version desktop backend is healthy.
Adds a startup-handoff mutex so a second shortcut click during cold startup cannot start a competing desktop handoff; an already-active desktop heartbeat also suppresses duplicate launches.

When an older service-off desktop backend lingers after an upgrade, resolves the exact localhost listener PID, terminates only that stale desktop backend, and continues through the established-runtime fast path instead of paying the full compatibility startup chain.

Preserves first-run runtime provisioning and background-service handoff through the unchanged v3.5.31 compatibility Bootstrap/Core executables; stale service-mode or unresolvable desktop handoffs still fall back there.
Preserves Download Engine v2/SAB behavior, Automation/Discover behavior, user state, and Metadata Server v0.3.3 compatibility.
regression_guards: Python compile validation for server.py, sab_engine.py and automation_engine.py
Windows x64 Go vet/build validation for the v3.5.32 launcher
NewzDeckBootstrap.exe, NewzDeckCore.exe, NewzDeckService.exe, NewzDeckTray.exe, NewzDeckPicker.exe, NewzDeckThumb.exe and NewzDeckYenc.exe remain byte-identical to v3.5.31
startup health endpoint returns only identity/mode/heartbeat data without download-engine probing
SAB and Automation background managers start only after the HTTP listener is created
stale desktop backend termination is gated by a verified NewzDeck health response, desktop mode, service_mode=false, and exact owning listener PID
service-mode and unresolvable stale-version paths remain delegated to the compatibility bootstrap
user data remains outside the application directory under the version-independent NewzDeck user root
